**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

- **§12.3 (p0044)** is dispositive: nothing restricts Customer from acquiring, licensing or using any product or service or engaging any supplier, and Vendor acknowledges Customer has made **no exclusivity** commitment. No requirements, sole-supplier, or "shall not procure from any third party" obligation appears anywhere.
- Other "exclusive" hits are non-responsive or in our favour: §13.1 non-exclusive licence *to us*, §19.4/§21.4/§30.2 non-exclusive remedies, §28.1–28.2 forum.
- **§7.2 (p0026)** disclose-and-match on more favourable offers is an MFN/right-to-match mechanic, not a prohibition on using alternatives — logged for the MFN rule, not flagged here.
- **§12.4 (p0046)** non-compete on developing/marketing/selling/acquiring competing products is the restrictive-covenant term for the non-compete rule (and is contradicted by §12.3); not double-flagged as sourcing exclusivity.

No redline proposed.
